name: Raw Data Parsing and Gradient Computation
aliases: Raw Volume Data Reader Gradient Computation
Volume Data Loading and Gradient Computation
definition: Parses raw information files to extract resolution, sample type, ratio, and endian. Reads raw data, computes gradients, and records min/max intensity values.
summary: This method parses raw binary volume data and metadata to initialize rendering, distinguished by its custom info file format and integrated gradient computation.
